translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: God had chosen Adam and Noah and the families of Abraham and 'Imran in preference to others.

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: Indeed Allah chose Adam, and Nooh, and the Family of Ibrahim, and the Family of Imran over the creation.

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: God chose Adam and Noah and the House of Abraham and the House of Imran above all beings, the

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: Verily did Allah choose Adam and Nuh and the house of lbrahim and the house of 'lmran out of the worlds

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: Allah chose Adam, Nuh (Noah), the family of Ibrahim (Abraham) and the family of 'Imran above the 'Alamin (mankind and jinns) (of their times).

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: God chose Adam, and Noah, and the family of Abraham, and the family of Imran, over all mankind.

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: Truly Allah chose Adam and Noah and the descendants of Abraham and of 'Imran above all mankind.

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: Allah chose Adam, Nuh (Noah), the family of Ibrahim and the family of `Imran above the nations.

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: Lo! Allah preferred Adam and Noah and the Family of Abraham and the Family of 'Imran above (all His) creatures.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: Allah chose Adam and Noah, the House of Abraham and the House of Imran above all worlds.

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: Indeed, Allah chose Adam and Noah and the family of Abraham and the family of 'Imran over the worlds -

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: God chose (and gave distinction to) Adam, Noah, the family of Abraham, and Imran over all the people of the world.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: Surely Allah chose Adam and Nuh and the descendants of Ibrahim and the descendants of Imran above the nations.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: God chose Adam and Noah and the family of Abraham and the family of 'Imran above all His creatures.

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: Allah did choose Adam and Noah, the family of Abraham, and the family of 'Imran above all people,-

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: They were descendants of one another; and God hears all and knows everything.

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: They are the descendants one of another; and Allah is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: seed of one another; God hears, and knows.

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: Progeny, one of the other, and Allah is Hearing, Knowing.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: Offspring, one of the other, and Allah is the All-Hearer, All-Knower.

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: Offspring one of the other. God is Hearer and Knower.

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: (for His messengership) - a people alike and the seed of one another. Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: Offspring, one of the other, and Allah is All-Hearer, All-Knower.

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: They were descendants one of another. Allah is Hearer, Knower.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: They were the offspring of one another. Allah is Hearing, and Knowing.

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: Descendants, some of them from others. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing.

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: They were the offspring of one another. God is All-hearing and All-seeing.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: Offspring one of the other; and Allah is Hearing, Knowing.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: They are the offspring of one another. God hears all and knows all.

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: Offspring, one of the other: And Allah heareth and knoweth all things.

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: Remember, when the wife of 'Imran prayed: "O Lord, I offer what I carry in my womb in dedication to Your service, accept it, for You hear all and know everything."

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: (Remember) When the wife of Imran said, “My Lord! I pledge to you what is in my womb – that it shall be dedicated purely in Your service, so accept it from me; indeed You only are the All Hearing, the All Knowing.”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: When the wife of Imran said, 'Lord, I have vowed to Thee, in dedication, what is within my womb. Receive Thou this from me; Thou hearest, and knowest.'

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: Recall what time the wife of 'lmran said my Lord verily have vowed unto Thee that which is in my belly to be dedicated; accept Thou then of me. Verily Thou! Thou art the Hearer, the Knower.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: (Remember) when the wife of 'Imran said: "O my Lord! I have vowed to You what (the child that) is in my womb to be dedicated for Your services (free from all worldly work; to serve Your Place of worship), so accept this, from me. Verily, You are the All-Hearer, the All-Knowing."

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: The wife of Imran said, “My Lord, I have vowed to You what is in my womb, dedicated, so accept from me; You are the Hearer and Knower.”

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: (He also heard) when the woman of 'Imran said: 'O Lord! Behold, unto You do I vow that the child in my womb is to be devoted to Your exclusive service. Accept it, then, from me. Surely You alone are All-Hearing, All-Knowing.'

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: (Remember) when the wife of `Imran said: "O my Lord! I have vowed to You what is in my womb to be dedicated for Your services, so accept this from me. Verily, You are the All-Hearer, the All-Knowing."

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: (Remember) when the wife of 'Imran said: My Lord! I have vowed unto Thee that which is in my belly as a consecrated (offering). Accept it from me. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Hearer, the Knower!

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: (Remember) when the wife of 'Imran said: 'Lord, I have vowed to You in dedication that which is hidden inside me. Accept this from me. You are the Hearer, the Knower'

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: [Mention, O Muhammad], when the wife of 'Imran said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing."

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: Remember when Imran's wife prayed to her Lord saying, "I have made a vow to dedicate to Your service whatever is in my womb. Lord, accept it from me. You are All-hearing and All-knowing".

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: When a woman of Imran said: My Lord! surely I vow to Thee what is in my womb, to be devoted (to Thy service); accept therefore from me, surely Thou art the Hearing, the Knowing.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: Remember when the wife of 'Imran said, "My Lord, I have dedicated what is in my womb entirely to Your service. So accept this from me. You are the One who hears and knows all."

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: Behold! a woman of 'Imran said: "O my Lord! I do dedicate unto Thee what is in my womb for Thy special service: So accept this of me: For Thou hearest and knowest all things."

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: And when she had given birth to the child, she said: "O Lord, I have delivered but a girl." -- But God knew better what she had delivered: A boy could not be as that girl was. "I have named her Mary," (she said), "and I give her into Your keeping. Preserve her and her children from Satan the ostracized."

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: So when she gave birth to it, she said, “My Lord! I have indeed given birth to a girl!” And Allah well knows what she gave birth to; and the boy she had prayed for is not like this girl; “And I have named her Maryam and I give her and her offspring in Your protection, against Satan the outcast.”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: And when she gave birth to her she said, 'Lord, I have given birth to her, a female.' (And God knew very well what she had given birth to; the male is not as the female.) 'And I have named her Mary, and commend her to Thee with her seed, to protect them from the accursed Satan.'

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: Then when she brought her forth, she said: my Lord verily have brought forth a female - and Allah knew best that which she had brought forth, - and the male is not as the female, and verily have named her Maryam, and verily seek refuge for her and her progeny with Thee from the Satan the accursed.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: Then when she delivered her [child Maryam (Mary)], she said: "O my Lord! I have delivered a female child," - and Allah knew better what she delivered, - "And the male is not like the female, and I have named her Maryam (Mary), and I seek refuge with You (Allah) for her and for her offspring from Shaitan (Satan), the outcast."

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: And when she delivered her, she said, “My Lord, I have delivered a female,” and God was well aware of what she has delivered, “and the male is not like the female, and I have named her Mary, and have commended her and her descendants to Your protection, from Satan the outcast.”

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: But when she gave birth to a female child, she said: 'O Lord! I have given birth to a female' - and Allah knew full well what she had given birth to - 'and a female is not the same as a male. I have named her Mary and commit her and her offspring to You for protection from Satan, the accursed.'

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: Then when she gave birth to her, she said: "O my Lord! I have given birth to a female child, ـ and Allah knew better what she bore, ـ "And the male is not like the female, and I have named her Maryam, and I seek refuge with You for her and for her offspring from Shaytan, the outcast."

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: And when she was delivered she said: My Lord! Lo! I am delivered of a female - Allah knew best of what she was delivered - the male is not as the female; and lo! I have named her Mary, and lo! I crave Thy protection for her and for her offspring from Satan the outcast.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: And when she was delivered of her, she said: 'Lord, I have given birth to her, a female' Allah knew of what she had given birth the male is not like the female 'and I have called her Mary. Protect her and all her descendants from satan, the stoned one'

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: But when she delivered her, she said, "My Lord, I have delivered a female." And Allah was most knowing of what she delivered, "And the male is not like the female. And I have named her Mary, and I seek refuge for her in You and [for] her descendants from Satan, the expelled [from the mercy of Allah]."

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: When the baby was born she said, "Lord, it is a female." God knew this. Male and female are not alike. "I have named her Mary. I pray that You will keep her and her offspring safe from Satan, the condemned one."

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: So when she brought forth, she said: My Lord! Surely I have brought it forth a female-- and Allah knew best what she brought forth-- and the male is not like the female, and I have named it Marium, and I commend her and her offspring into Thy protection from the accursed Shaitan.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: When she gave birth, she said, "My Lord, I have given birth to a girl," God knew very well what she had given birth to: a male is not like a female, "I have named her Mary and placed her and her children in Your protection from the rejected Satan."

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: When she was delivered, she said: "O my Lord! Behold! I am delivered of a female child!"- and Allah knew best what she brought forth- "And no wise is the male Like the female. I have named her Mary, and I commend her and her offspring to Thy protection from the Evil One, the Rejected."

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: Her Lord accepted her graciously, and she grew up with excellence, and was given into the care of Zachariah. Whenever Zachariah came to see her in the chamber, he found her provided with food, and he asked: "Where has this come from, O Mary?" And she said: "From God who gives food in abundance to whomsoever He will."

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: So her Lord fully accepted her (Maryam), and gave her an excellent development; and gave her in Zakaria’s guardianship; whenever Zakaria visited her at her place of prayer, he found new food with her; he said, “O Maryam! From where did this come to you?” She answered, “It is from Allah; indeed Allah gives to whomever He wills, without limit account.” (Miracles occur through the friends of Allah.)

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: Her Lord received the child with gracious favour, and by His goodness she grew up comely, Zachariah taking charge of her. Whenever Zachariah went in to her in the Sanctuary, he found her provisioned. 'Mary,' he said, 'how comes this to thee?' 'From God,' she said. Truly God provisions whomsoever He will without reckoning.

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: Then her Lord accepted her with goodly acceptance and made her grow up with a goodly growth, and He made Zakariyya take care of her. So oft as Zakariyya entered the apartment to see her, he found provision by her. He said: O Maryam! whence hast thou this! She said this is from before Allah. Verily Allah provideth for whomsoever He will without reckoning.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: So her Lord (Allah) accepted her with goodly acceptance. He made her grow in a good manner and put her under the care of Zakariya (Zachariya). Every time he entered Al-Mihrab to (visit) her, he found her supplied with sustenance. He said: "O Maryam (Mary)! From where have you got this?" She said, "This is from Allah." Verily, Allah provides sustenance to whom He wills, without limit."

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: Her Lord accepted her with a gracious reception, and brought her a beautiful upbringing, and entrusted her to the care of Zechariah. Whenever Zechariah entered upon her in the sanctuary, he found her with provision. He said, “O Mary, where did you get this from?” She said, “It is from God; God provides to whom He wills without reckoning.”

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: Thereupon her Lord graciously accepted Mary and vouchsafed to her a goodly growth and placed her in the care of Zechariah. Whenever Zechariah visited her in the sanctuary, he found her provided with food. He asked her: 'O Mary, how did this come to you?' She said: 'It is from Allah. Allah provides sustenance to whom He wills beyond all reckoning.'

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: So her Lord (Allah) accepted her with goodly acceptance. He made her grow in a good manner and put her under the care of Zakariyya. Every time he entered the Mihrab to (visit) her, he found her supplied with sustenance. He said: "O Maryam! From where have you gotten this" She said, "This is from Allah." Verily, Allah provides sustenance to whom He wills, without limit.

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: And her Lord accepted her with full acceptance and vouchsafed to her a goodly growth; and made Zachariah her guardian. Whenever Zachariah went into the sanctuary where she was, he found that she had food. He said: O Mary! Whence cometh unto thee this (food)? She answered: It is from Allah. Allah giveth without stint to whom He will.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: Her Lord graciously accepted her. He made her grow with a fine upbringing and entrusted her to the care of Zachariah. Whenever Zachariah went to her in the sanctuary, he found that she had provision with her. 'Mary' he said, 'how does this come to you' 'It is from Allah' she answered. Truly, Allah provides whomsoever He will without reckoning.

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allah. Indeed, Allah provides for whom He wills without account."

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: Her Lord graciously accepted the offer and made Mary grow up, pure, and beautiful. Zachariah took custody of her. Whenever he went to visit her in her place of worship, he would find with her some food. He would ask her, "Where did this food come from?" She would reply, "God has sent it." God gives sustenance to whomever He wants without keeping an account.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: So her Lord accepted her with a good acceptance and made her grow up a good growing, and gave her into the charge of Zakariya; whenever Zakariya entered the sanctuary to (see) her, he found with her food. He said: O Marium! whence comes this to you? She said: It is from Allah. Surely Allah gives to whom He pleases without measure.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: Her Lord graciously accepted her and made her grow in goodness and entrusted her to the care of Zachariah. Every time Zachariah visited her in her chamber he found some provision with her. He asked, "Mary, where did this provision come from?" She replied, "This is from God. God provides for whoever He wills without measure."

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: Right graciously did her Lord accept her: He made her grow in purity and beauty: To the care of Zakariya was she assigned. Every time that he entered (Her) chamber to see her, He found her supplied with sustenance. He said: "O Mary! Whence (comes) this to you?" She said: "From Allah: for Allah Provides sustenance to whom He pleases without measure."

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: Then prayed Zachariah to his Lord: "O Lord, bestow on me offspring, virtuous and good, for You answer all prayers."

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: It is here that Zakaria prayed to his Lord; he said, “My Lord! Give me from Yourself a righteous child; indeed You only are the Listener Of Prayer.”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: Then Zachariah prayed to his Lord saying, 'Lord, give me of Thy goodness a goodly offspring. Yea, Thou hearest prayer.'

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: Forthwith Zakariyya prayed unto his Lord my Lord bestow on me from Thine presence a goodly offspring; verily Thou! Thou art the Hearer of prayer.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: At that time Zakariya (Zachariya) invoked his Lord, saying: "O my Lord! Grant me from You, a good offspring. You are indeed the All-Hearer of invocation."

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: Thereupon Zechariah prayed to his Lord; he said, “My Lord, bestow on me good offspring from Your presence; You are the Hearer of Prayers.”

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: Then Zechariah prayed to his Lord: 'O Lord! Grant me from Yourself out of Your grace the gift of a goodly offspring, for indeed You alone heed all Prayers.'

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: At that time Zakariyya invoked his Lord, saying: "O my Lord! Grant me from You, a good offspring. You are indeed the All-Hearer of invocation."

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: Then Zachariah prayed unto his Lord and said: My Lord! Bestow upon me of Thy bounty goodly offspring. Lo! Thou art the Hearer of Prayer.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: Thereupon Zachariah supplicated to his Lord, saying: 'Lord, give me from You a good offspring. You hear all prayers'

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: At that, Zechariah called upon his Lord, saying, "My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication."

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: Zachariah prayed to his Lord there, saying, "Lord, grant me, by Your Grace, virtuous offspring. You hear all prayers".

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: There did Zakariya pray to his Lord; he said: My Lord! grant me from Thee good offspring; surely Thou art the Hearer of prayer.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: Thereupon Zachariah prayed to his Lord, saying, "Lord, grant me by Your own grace virtuous offspring. You are the hearer of all prayers."

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: There did Zakariya pray to his Lord, saying: "O my Lord! Grant unto me from Thee a progeny that is pure: for Thou art He that heareth prayer!

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: Then the angels said to him as he stood in the chamber at prayer: "God sends you good tidings of John who will confirm a thing from God and be noble, continent, and a prophet, and one of those who are upright and do good."

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: And the angels called out to him while he was standing, offering prayer at his place of worship, “Indeed Allah gives you glad tidings of Yahya (John), who will confirm a Word (or sign) from Allah, – a leader, always refraining from women, a Prophet from one of Our devoted ones.”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: And the angels called to him, standing in the Sanctuary at worship, 'Lo, God gives thee good tidings of John, who shall confirm a Word of God, a chief, and chaste, a Prophet, righteous.'

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: Then the angels called unto him even while he stood Praying in the apartment: verily Allah announceth unto thee Yahya confessing to a word from Allah, and a leader, and a chaste and a prophet of the righteous one.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: Then the angels called him, while he was standing in prayer in Al-Mihrab (a praying place or a private room), (saying): "Allah gives you glad tidings of Yahya (John), confirming (believing in) the Word from Allah [i.e. the creation of 'Iesa (Jesus), the Word from Allah ("Be!" - and he was!)], noble, keeping away from sexual relations with women, a Prophet, from among the righteous."

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: Then the angels called out to him, as he stood praying in the sanctuary: “God gives you good news of John; confirming a Word from God, and honorable, and moral, and a prophet; one of the upright.”

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: As he stood praying in the sanctuary, the angels called out to him: 'Allah gives you good tidings of John (Yahya), who shall confirm a command of Allah, shall be outstanding among men, utterly chaste, and a Prophet from among the righteous.'

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: Then the angels called him, while he was standing in prayer in the Mihrab, (saying): "Allah gives you glad tidings of Yahya, believing in the Word from Allah, and Sayyidan, and Hasuran, a Prophet, from among the righteous."

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: And the angels called to him as he stood praying in the sanctuary: Allah giveth thee glad tidings of (a son whose name is) John, (who cometh) to confirm a word from Allah lordly, chaste, a prophet of the righteous.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: And the angels called out to him when he was standing in the sanctuary worshipping, saying: 'Allah gives you glad tidings of John, who shall confirm a Word from Allah. He shall be a master and chaste, a Prophet and from the righteous'

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: So the angels called him while he was standing in prayer in the chamber, "Indeed, Allah gives you good tidings of John, confirming a word from Allah and [who will be] honorable, abstaining [from women], and a prophet from among the righteous."

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: When he was standing during prayer in his place of worship, the angels called him saying, "God gives you the glad news of the birth of your son, John who will be a confirmation of (Jesus) the Word of God. He will become a chaste, noble leader and one of the righteous Prophets.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: Then the angels called to him as he stood praying in the sanctuary: That Allah gives you the good news of Yahya verifying a Word from Allah, and honorable and chaste and a prophet from among the good ones.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: As he stood praying in the chamber, the angels called out to him, saying, "God gives you the good news of John, who shall confirm the Word from God, and [shall be] outstanding among men, and utterly chaste, and a prophet from among the righteous."

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: While he was standing in prayer in the chamber, the angels called unto him: "Allah doth give thee glad tidings of Yahya, witnessing the truth of a Word from Allah, and (be besides) noble, chaste, and a prophet,- of the (goodly) company of the righteous."

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: "How can I have a son, O Lord," he said, "for I am old and my wife is barren?" "Thus," came the answer, "God does as He wills."

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: He said, “My Lord! How can I have a son when old age has reached me and my wife is barren?” He said, “This is how Allah brings about, whatever He wills.”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: 'Lord,' said Zachariah, 'how shall I have a son, seeing I am an old man and my wife is barren?' 'Even so,' God said, 'God does what He will.'

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: He said: my Lord! in what wise shall there be unto me a youth whereas age hath overtaken me and my wife is barren. Allah said: even so: Allah doeth whatsoever He listeth.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: He said: "O my Lord! How can I have a son when I am very old, and my wife is barren?" Allah said: "Thus Allah does what He wills."

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: He said, “My Lord, how will I have a son, when old age has overtaken me, and my wife is barren?” He said, “Even so, God does whatever He wills.”

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: Zechariah exclaimed: 'My Lord! How shall I have a son when old age has overtaken me and my wife is barren?' He said: Thus shall it be; Allah does what He wills.'

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: He said: "O my Lord! How can I have a son when I am very old, and my wife is barren" (Allah) said: "Thus Allah does what He wills."

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: He said: My Lord! How can I have a son when age hath overtaken me already and my wife is barren? (The angel) answered: So (it will be). Allah doeth what He will.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: He said: 'Lord, how shall I have a son when I am overtaken by old age and my wife is barren' He said: 'Even so, Allah does what He will'

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" The angel said, "Such is Allah; He does what He wills."

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: He said, "How can there be a son for me when I am already senile and my wife is barren." The angel replied, "God does as He wills."

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: He said: My Lord! when shall there be a son (born) to me, and old age has already come upon me, and my wife is barren? He said: even thus does Allah what He pleases.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: "Lord," said Zachariah, "how shall I have a son when I am now overtaken by old age and my wife is barren?" "Such is the will of God," replied [the angel], "He does what He pleases."

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: He said: "O my Lord! How shall I have son, seeing I am very old, and my wife is barren?" "Thus," was the answer, "Doth Allah accomplish what He willeth."

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: And Zachariah said: "Give me a token, O Lord." "The token will be," was the reply, "that you will speak to no man for three days except by signs; and remember your Lord much, and pray at evening and sunrise."

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: He said, “My Lord! Determine a sign for me”; He said, “The sign is that you shall not be able to speak to mankind for three days except by signs; and remember your Lord profusely, and proclaim His Purity before sunset and at dawn.”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: 'Lord,' said Zachariah, 'appoint to me a sign.' 'Thy sign,' God said, 'is that thou shalt not speak, save by tokens, to men for three days. And mention thy Lord oft, and give glory at evening and dawn.'

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: He said: my Lord! appoint unto me a sign. Allah said: thy sign is that thou shalt not speak unto mankind for three days save by beckoning; and remember thy Lord much and hallow Him in the evening and morning.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: He said: "O my Lord! Make a sign for me." Allah said: "Your sign is that you shall not speak to mankind for three days except with signals. And remember your Lord much (by praising Him again and again), and glorify (Him) in the afternoon and in the morning."

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: He said, “My Lord, give me a sign.” He said, “Your sign is that you shall not speak to the people for three days, except by gestures. And remember your Lord much, and praise in the evening and the morning.”

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: Zechariah said: 'O my Lord! Appoint a sign for me.' The angel said: 'The sign for you shall be that you shall not speak to men for three days except by gesture. Remember your Lord and extol His glory by night and by day.'

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: He said: "O my Lord! Make a sign for me." (Allah) said: "Your sign is that you shall not speak to the people for three days except by signals. And remember your Lord much, and glorify (Him) in the afternoon and in the morning."

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: He said: My Lord! Appoint a token for me. (The angel) said: The token unto thee (shall be) that thou shalt not speak unto mankind three days except by signs. Remember thy Lord much, and praise (Him) in the early hours of night and morning.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: He said: 'Lord, appoint for me a sign' He said: 'Your sign is that you shall not speak to people except by signs for three days' And remember your Lord abundantly, exalt Him in the evening and at the dawn'

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: He said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He Said, "Your sign is that you will not [be able to] speak to the people for three days except by gesture. And remember your Lord much and exalt [Him with praise] in the evening and the morning."

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: Zachariah prayed to God saying, "Lord, show me the evidence (that it is Divine revelation)." The Lord replied, "You must not speak to people for three days except with gestures. Commemorate your Lord often and glorify Him in the early mornings and the evenings."

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: He said: My Lord! appoint a sign for me. Said He: Your sign is that you should not speak to men for three days except by signs; and remember your Lord much and glorify Him in the evening and the morning.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: He said, "My Lord, grant me a sign." [The angel] said, "Your sign is that you will not be able to speak to people for three days except by signs. Remember your Lord much and glorify Him morning and evening."

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: He said: "O my Lord! Give me a Sign!" "Thy Sign," was the answer, "Shall be that thou shalt speak to no man for three days but with signals. Then celebrate the praises of thy Lord again and again, and glorify Him in the evening and in the morning."

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: The angels said: "O Mary, indeed God has favoured you and made you immaculate, and chosen you from all the women of the world.

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: And when the angels said, “O Maryam! Indeed Allah has chosen you and purified you, and has this day, chosen you among all the women of the world.”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: And when the angels said, 'Mary, God has chosen thee, and purified thee; He has chosen thee above all women.

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: And recall what time the angels said: O Maryam! verily Allah chose thee and purified thee and chose thee above the women of the worlds.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: And (remember) when the angels said: "O Maryam (Mary)! Verily, Allah has chosen you, purified you (from polytheism and disbelief), and chosen you above the women of the 'Alamin (mankind and jinns) (of her lifetime)."

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: The angels said, “O Mary, God has chosen you, and has purified you. He has chosen you over all the women of the world.

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: Then came the time when the angels said: 'O Mary! Behold, Allah has chosen you, and made you pure, and exalted you above all the women in the world.

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: And (remember) when the angels said: "O Maryam! Verily, Allah has chosen you, purified you, and chosen you above the women of the nations."

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: And when the angels said: O Mary! Lo! Allah hath chosen thee and made thee pure, and hath preferred thee above (all) the women of creation.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: And when the angels said to Mary: 'Allah has chosen you and purified you. He has chosen you above all women of the worlds.

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allah has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds.

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: "Behold," the angels told Mary, "God had chosen you, purified you, and given you distinction over all women.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: And when the angels said: O Marium! surely Allah has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the world.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: The angels said, "Mary, God has selected you and purified you. He has selected you over [all] the women of your time.

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: Behold! the angels said: "O Mary! Allah hath chosen thee and purified thee- chosen thee above the women of all nations.

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: So adore your Lord, O Mary, and pay homage and bow with those who bow in prayer."

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: “O Maryam! Stand in reverence before your Lord, prostrate yourself and bow along with those who bow.”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: Mary; be obedient to thy Lord, prostrating and bowing before Him.'

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: Maryam! be devout unto thy Lord, prostrate thyself, and bow down with them that bow down.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: O Mary! "Submit yourself with obedience to your Lord (Allah, by worshipping none but Him Alone) and prostrate yourself, and Irka'i (bow down etc.) along with Ar-Raki'un (those who bow down etc.)."

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: “O Mary, be devoted to your Lord, and bow down, and kneel with those who kneel.”

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: O Mary! Remain devout to your Lord, and prostrate yourself in worship, and bow with those who bow (before Him).'

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: "O Maryam! Submit yourself with obedience (Aqnuti) to your Lord and prostrate yourself, and bow down along with Ar-Raki`in."

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: O Mary! Be obedient to thy Lord, prostrate thyself and bow with those who bow (in worship).

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: Mary, be obedient to your Lord, prostrate and bow with those who bow'

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: O Mary, be devoutly obedient to your Lord and prostrate and bow with those who bow [in prayer]."

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: Mary, pray devotedly to your Lord, prostrate yourself before Him and bow down with those who bow down before Him."

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: O Marium! keep to obedience to your Lord and humble yourself, and bow down with those who bow.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: O Mary! Remain truly devout to your Sustainer, and prostrate yourself in worship, and bow down with those who bow down [before Him]."

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: "O Mary! worship Thy Lord devoutly: Prostrate thyself, and bow down (in prayer) with those who bow down."

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: This is news of the Unknown that We send you, for you were not there when they cast lots with quills (to determine) who should take care of Mary, nor when they disputed it.

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: These are tidings of the hidden, which We secretly reveal to you (O dear Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him); and you were not present with them when they threw their pens to draw lots, to know who should be the guardian of Maryam; nor were you present with them when they were quarrelling. (Yet you know of these things – this is a proof of your being a Prophet.)

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: (That is of the tidings of the Unseen, that We reveal to thee; for thou wast not with them, when they were casting quills which of them should have charge of Mary; thou wast not with them, when they were disputing.)

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: This is of the tidings of things hidden which We reveal unto thee and thou wast not with them when they cast their reeds as to which of them should take care of Maryam, nor wast thou with them when they disputed.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: This is a part of the news of the Ghaib (unseen, i.e. the news of the past nations of which you have no knowledge) which We inspire you with (O Muhammad SAW). You were not with them, when they cast lots with their pens as to which of them should be charged with the care of Maryam (Mary); nor were you with them when they disputed.

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: These are accounts from the Unseen, which We reveal to you. You were not with them when they cast their lots as to which of them would take charge of Mary; nor were you with them as they quarreled.

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: (O Muhammad!) We reveal to you this account from a realm which lies beyond the reach of your perception for you were not with them when they drew lots with their pens about who should be Mary's guardian, and you were not with them when they disputed about it.

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: This is a part of the news of the Ghayb (Unseen) which We reveal to you. You were not with them, when they cast lots with their pens as to which of them should be charged with the care of Maryam; nor were you with them when they disputed.

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: This is of the tidings of things hidden. We reveal it unto thee (Muhammad). Thou wast not present with them when they threw their pens (to know) which of them should be the guardian of Mary, nor wast thou present with them when they quarrelled (thereupon).

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: This is from the news of the unseen. We reveal it to you (Prophet Muhammad). You were not present when they cast their quills to see which of them should look after Mary, nor were you present when they were disputing.

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you, [O Muhammad]. And you were not with them when they cast their pens as to which of them should be responsible for Mary. Nor were you with them when they disputed.

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: (Muhammad), that was some of the news about the unseen, that We have revealed to you. You were not among those who cast lots by throwing their arrows to find out who would take custody of Mary, nor were you among those who disputed the matter.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: This is of the announcements relating to the unseen which We reveal to you; and you were not with them when they cast their pens (to decide) which of them should have Marium in his charge, and you were not with them when they contended one with another.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: This is an account of the unseen, which We reveal to you. You were not with them when they drew lots as to which of them should be Mary's guardian and you were not with them when they disputed with one another.

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: This is part of the tidings of the things unseen, which We reveal unto thee (O Messenger!) by inspiration: Thou wast not with them when they cast lots with arrows, as to which of them should be charged with the care of Mary: Nor wast thou with them when they disputed (the point).

translations.author: Dr. Muhammad Muhsin
translations.text:
Narrated 'Ali:
I heard the Prophet saying, "Mary, the daughter of 'Imran, was the best among the women (of the world of her time) and Khadija is the best amongst the women. (of this nation)."

translations.author: Dr. Muhammad Muhsin
translations.text:
Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ashari:
The Prophet said, "The superiority of 'Aisha to other ladies is like the superiority of Tharid (i.e. meat and bread dish) to other meals. Many men reached the level of perfection, but no woman reached such a level except Mary, the daughter of Imran and Asia, the wife of Pharaoh."
Narrated Abu Huraira: I heard Allah's Apostle saying, "Amongst all those women who ride camels (i.e. Arabs), the ladies of Quraish are the best. They are merciful and kind to their off-spring and the best guardians of their husbands' properties.' Abu Huraira added, "Mary the daughter of Imran never rode a camel."

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: When the angels said: "O Mary, God gives you news of a thing from Him, for rejoicing, (news of one) whose name will be Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, illustrious in this world and the next, and one among the honoured,

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: And remember when the angels said, “O Maryam! Allah gives you glad tidings of a Word from Him, whose name is the Messiah, Eisa the son of Maryam – he will be honourable in this world and in the Hereafter, and among the close ones (to Allah).”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: When the angels said, 'Mary, God gives thee good tidings of a Word from Him whose name is Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary; high honoured shall he be in this world and the next, near stationed to God.

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: Recall what time the angels said: Maryam! verily Allah announceth unto thee a word from Him: his name Shall be the Masih, Isa, son of Maryam, illustrious in the world and the Hereafter and one of those brought nigh.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: (Remember) when the angels said: "O Maryam (Mary)! Verily, Allah gives you the glad tidings of a Word ["Be!" - and he was! i.e. 'Iesa (Jesus) the son of Maryam (Mary)] from Him, his name will be the Messiah 'Iesa (Jesus), the son of Maryam (Mary), held in honour in this world and in the Hereafter, and will be one of those who are near to Allah."

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: The Angels said, “O Mary, God gives you good news of a Word from Him. His name is the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, well-esteemed in this world and the next, and one of the nearest.

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: And when the angels said: 'O Mary! Allah gives you the glad tidings of a command from Him: his name shall be Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary. He shall be highly honoured in this world and in the Next, and shall be one of those near stationed to Allah.

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: (Remember) when the angels said: "O Maryam! Verily, Allah gives you the glad tidings of a Word from Him, his name will be Al-Masih, `Isa, the son of Maryam, held in honor in this world and in the Hereafter, and he will be one of those who are near to Allah."

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: (And remember) when the angels said: O Mary! Lo! Allah giveth thee glad tidings of a word from him, whose name is the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, illustrious in the world and the Hereafter, and one of those brought near (unto Allah).

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: When the angels said: 'O Mary, Allah gives you glad tidings of a Word (Be) from Him, whose name is Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary. He shall be honored in this world and in the Everlasting Life and he shall be among those who are close.

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: [And mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allah gives you good tidings of a word from Him, whose name will be the Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary - distinguished in this world and the Hereafter and among those brought near [to Allah].

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: "Behold," the angels told Mary, "God has given you the glad news of the coming birth of a son whom He calls His Word, whose name will be Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, who will be a man of honor in this life and the life to come, and who will be one of the ones nearest to God.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: When the angels said: O Marium, surely Allah gives you good news with a Word from Him (of one) whose name is the '. Messiah, Isa son of Marium, worthy of regard in this world and the hereafter and of those who are made near (to Allah).

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: When the angels said, "O Mary, your Lord gives you good news of a Word from Him. His name is the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, honoured in this world and in the next and one of those who are granted nearness to God.

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: Behold! the angels said: "O Mary! Allah giveth thee glad tidings of a Word from Him: his name will be Christ Jesus, the son of Mary, held in honour in this world and the Hereafter and of (the company of) those nearest to Allah;

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: Who will speak to the people when in the cradle and when in the prime of life, and will be among the upright and doers of good."

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: “He will speak to people while he is in the cradle and in his adulthood, and will be of the devoted ones.”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: He shall speak to men in the cradle, and of age, and righteous he shall be.'

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: And he shall speak unto mankind from the cradle and in maturity; and be one of the righteous.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: "He will speak to the people in the cradle and in manhood, and he will be one of the righteous."

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: He will speak to the people from the crib, and in adulthood, and will be one of the righteous.”

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: And he shall speak to men in the cradle and also later when he grows to maturity and shall indeed be among the righteous.'

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: "He will speak to the people, in the cradle and in manhood, and he will be one of the righteous."

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: He will speak unto mankind in his cradle and in his manhood, and he is of the righteous.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: He shall speak to people in his cradle and when he is aged, and shall be among the righteous'

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: He will speak to the people in the cradle and in maturity and will be of the righteous."

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: He will speak to the people while in his cradle and preach to them when he will be a man. He will be one of the righteous ones.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: And he shall speak to the people when in the cradle and when of old age, and (he shall be) one of the good ones.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: And he shall speak to men in his cradle, and as a grown man, and shall be one of the righteous."

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: "He shall speak to the people in childhood and in maturity. And he shall be (of the company) of the righteous."

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: She said: "How can I have a son, O Lord, when no man has touched me?" He said: "That is how God creates what He wills. When He decrees a thing, He says 'Be', and it is.

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: She said, “My Lord! How can I bear a child when no man has ever touched me?” He said, “This is how Allah creates whatever He wills; when He wills a thing, He only says to it, ‘Be’ – and it happens immediately.”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: 'Lord,' said Mary, 'how shall I have a son seeing no mortal has touched me?' 'Even so,' God said, God creates what He will. When He decrees a thing He does but say to it "Be," and it is.

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: She said: my Lord! in what wise shall there be unto me a son whereas no human being hath touched me. Allah said: even so. Allah createth whatsoever He will, When He hath decreed a thing, He only saith to it: Be, and it becometh;

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: She said: "O my Lord! How shall I have a son when no man has touched me." He said: "So (it will be) for Allah creates what He wills. When He has decreed something, He says to it only: "Be!" and it is.

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: She said, “My Lord, how can I have a child, when no man has touched me?” He said, “It will be so. God creates whatever He wills. To have anything done, He only says to it, ‘Be,’ and it is.”

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: She said: 'O my Lord! How shall I have a son when no man has ever touched me?' The angel answered: Thus shall it be. Allah creates whatever He wills. When He decides something, He merely says: "Be" and it is.

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: She said: "O my Lord! How shall I have a son when no man has touched me." He said: "So (it will be) for Allah creates what He wills. When He has decreed something, He says to it only: `Be! ـ and it is."

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: She said: My Lord! How can I have a child when no mortal hath touched me? He said: So (it will be). Allah createth what He will. If He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: 'Lord' she said, 'how can I bear a child when no human being has touched me' He replied: 'Such is the Will of Allah. He creates whom He will. When He decrees a thing, He only says: "Be," and it is.

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: She said, "My Lord, how will I have a child when no man has touched me?" [The angel] said, "Such is Allah; He creates what He wills. When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, 'Be,' and it is.

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: (Mary) said, "How can there be a son for me when no mortal has touched me?" The angel replied, "That is how God creates whatever He wants. When He decides to do something He just orders it to exist and it comes into existence."

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: She said: My Lord! when shall there be a son (born) to I me, and man has not touched me? He said: Even so, Allah creates what He pleases; when He has decreed a matter, He only says to it, Be, and it is.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: "Lord," she said, "how can I have a child when no man has touched me?" [The angel] replied, "Thus it is: God creates what He wills: when He wills a thing He need only say, "Be," and it is.

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: She said: "O my Lord! How shall I have a son when no man hath touched me?" He said: "Even so: Allah createth what He willeth: When He hath decreed a plan, He but saith to it, 'Be,' and it is!

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: Commemorate Mary in the Book. When she withdrew from her family to a place in the East

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: And remember Maryam in the Book; when she went away from her family to a place towards east.

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: And mention in the Book Mary when she withdrew from her people to an eastern place,

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: And mention thou in the Book Maryam, what time the retired from her people to a place eastward.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: And mention in the Book (the Quran, O Muhammad SAW, the story of) Maryam (Mary), when she withdrew in seclusion from her family to a place facing east.

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: And mention in the Scripture Mary, when she withdrew from her people to an eastern location.

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: (O Muhammad), recite in the Book the account of Mary, when she withdrew from her people to a place towards the east;

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: And mention in the Book, Maryam, when she withdrew in seclusion from her family to place facing east.

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: And make mention of Mary in the Scripture, when she had withdrawn from her people to a chamber looking East,

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: And mention in the Book, Mary, how she withdrew from her people to an eastern place and she took a veil apart from them;

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: And mention, [O Muhammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: (Muhammad), mention in the Book (the Quran) the story of Mary how she left her family and started living in a solitary place to the East

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: And mention Marium in the Book when she drew aside from her family to an eastern place;

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: Recount in the Book how Mary withdrew from her people to an eastern place

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: Relate in the Book (the story of) Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place in the East.

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: And took cover from them, We sent a spirit of Ours to her who appeared before her in the concrete form of a man.

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: So there she screened herself from them; We therefore sent Our Spirit towards her – he appeared before her in the form of a healthy man. (Angel Jibreel – peace be upon him.)

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: and she took a veil apart from them; then We sent unto her Our Spirit that presented himself to her a man without fault.

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: Then she took beside them a curtain; then We sent unto her Our Spirit, and he took unto her the form of a human being sound.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: She placed a screen (to screen herself) from them; then We sent to her Our Ruh [angel Jibrael (Gabriel)], and he appeared before her in the form of a man in all respects.

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: She screened herself away from them, and We sent to her Our spirit, and He appeared to her as an immaculate human.

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: and drew a curtain, screening herself from people whereupon We sent to her Our spirit and he appeared to her as a well-shaped man.

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: She placed a screen before them; then We sent to her Our Ruh, and he appeared before her in the form of a man in all respects.

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: And had chosen seclusion from them. Then We sent unto her Our Spirit and it assumed for her the likeness of a perfect man.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: We sent to her Our Spirit (Gabriel) in the resemblance of a perfect human.

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel, and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: out of her people's sight. We sent Our Spirit to her, who stood before her in the shape of a well formed human being.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: So she took a veil (to screen herself) from them; then We sent to her Our spirit, and there appeared to her a well-made man.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: and kept herself in seclusion from them. We sent her Our angel, who presented himself to her as a full-grown human being.

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: She placed a screen (to screen herself) from them; then We sent her our angel, and he appeared before her as a man in all respects.

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: "I seek refuge in the Merciful from you, if you fear Him," she said.

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: She said, “I seek the refuge of the Most Gracious from you – if you fear God.”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: She said, 'I take refuge in the All-merciful from thee!

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: She said: verily seek refuge with the Compassionate from thee if thou art God-fearing.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: She said: "Verily! I seek refuge with the Most Beneficent (Allah) from you, if you do fear Allah."

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: She said, “I take refuge from you in the Most Merciful, should you be righteous.”

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: Mary exclaimed: "I surely take refuge from you with the Most Compassionate Lord, if you are at all God-fearing."

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: She said: "Verily, I seek refuge with the Most Gracious (Allah) from you, if you do fear Allah."

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: She said: Lo! I seek refuge in the Beneficent One from thee, if thou art Allah-fearing.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: (And when she saw him) she said: 'I take refuge in the Merciful from you! If you are fearful'

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allah."

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: Mary said, "Would that the Beneficent God would protect me from you. Leave me alone if you are a God fearing person".

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: She said: Surely I fly for refuge from you to the Beneficent Allah, if you are one guarding (against evil).

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: When she saw him, she said, "I seek refuge in the compassionate God from you; [do not come near] if you fear the Lord."

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: She said: "I seek refuge from thee to (Allah) Most Gracious: (come not near) if thou dost fear Allah."

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: He replied: "I am only a messenger from your Lord (sent) to bestow a good son on you."

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: He said, “I am indeed one sent by your Lord; so that I may give you a chaste son.”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: If thou fearest God... He said, 'I am but a messenger come from thy Lord, to give thee a boy most pure.

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: He said: I am but a meenger from thy Lord that I may bestow on thee a boy pure.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: (The angel) said: "I am only a Messenger from your Lord, (to announce) to you the gift of a righteous son."

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: He said, “I am only the messenger of your Lord, to give you the gift of a pure son.”

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: He said: "I am just a message-bearer of your Lord, I have come to grant you a most pure boy."

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: (The angel) said: "I am only a messenger from your Lord, (to announce) to you the gift of a righteous son."

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: He said: I am only a messenger of thy Lord, that I may bestow on thee a faultless son.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: 'I am the Messenger of your Lord' he replied, 'and have come to give you a pure boy'

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy."

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: He said, "I am the Messengers of your Lord. I have come to give you a purified son".

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: He said: I am only a messenger of your Lord: That I will give you a pure boy.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: "I am only the messenger of your Lord," he replied. "I shall bestow upon you the gift of a son endowed with purity."

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: He said: "Nay, I am only a messenger from thy Lord, (to announce) to thee the gift of a holy son.

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: "How can I have a son," she said, "when no man has touched me, nor am I sinful?"

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: She said, “How can I bear a son? No man has ever touched me, nor am I of poor conduct!”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: She said, 'How shall I have a son whom no mortal has touched, neither have I been unchaste?'

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: She said: in what wise shall there be a boy unto me, whereas not a human being hath touched me, nor have I been a harlot?

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: She said: "How can I have a son, when no man has touched me, nor am I unchaste?"

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: She said, “How can I have a son, when no man has touched me, and I was never unchaste?”

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: Mary said: "How can a boy be born to me when no man has even touched me, nor have I ever been unchaste?"

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: She said: "How can I have a son when no man has touched me, nor am I Baghiyya"

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: She said: How can I have a son when no mortal hath touched me, neither have I been unchaste?

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: 'How shall I bear a son' she answered, 'when I am not touched by a human and not unchaste'

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: She said, "How can I have a son when no mortal has touched me nor am I an unchaste woman".

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: She said: When shall I have a boy and no mortal has yet touched me, nor have I been unchaste?

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: She said, "How can I have a son when no man has touched me; and neither have I been unchaste?"

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: She said: "How shall I have a son, seeing that no man has touched me, and I am not unchaste?"

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: He said: "Thus will it be. Your Lord said: 'It is easy for Me,' and that: 'We shall make him a sign for men and a blessing from Us.' This is a thing already decreed."

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: He said, “So it is; your Lord has said, ‘This is easy for Me’; and in order that We make him a sign for mankind and a Mercy from Us; and this matter has been decreed.”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: He said, 'Even so thy Lord has said: "Easy is that for Me; and that We may appoint him a sign unto men and a mercy from Us; it is a thing decreed."'

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: He said: even so! Thy Lord saith: it is With Me easy, and it is in order that We may make him a sign unto mankind and a mercy from Us, and it is an affair decreed.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: He said: "So (it will be), your Lord said: 'That is easy for Me (Allah): And (We wish) to appoint him as a sign to mankind and a mercy from Us (Allah), and it is a matter (already) decreed, (by Allah). 

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: He said, “Thus said your Lord, `It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign for humanity, and a mercy from Us. It is a matter already decided.'“

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: The angel said: "Thus shall it be. Your Lord says: 'It is easy for Me; and We shall do so in order to make him a Sign for mankind and a mercy from Us. This has been decreed.' "

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: He said: "Thus says your Lord: `That is easy for Me (Allah). And (We wish) to appoint him as a sign to mankind and a mercy from Us (Allah), and it is a matter (already) decreed (by Allah)."'

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me. And (it will be) that We may make of him a revelation for mankind and a mercy from Us, and it is a thing ordained.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: "Even so" he replied, "as such your Lord has said: 'Easy it is for Me. And We shall make him a sign to mankind and a mercy from Us. It is a matter decreed.'"

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.' "

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: He said, "This is true but your Lord says, "It is very easy for Me. We have decided to give you a son as evidence (of Our existence) for human beings and a mercy from Us. This is a decree already ordained."

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: He said: Even so; your Lord says: It is easy to Me: and that We may make him a sign to men and a mercy from Us, and it is a matter which has been decreed.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: [The angel] replied, "So shall it be; your Lord says, 'This is easy for Me; and We shall make him a sign to people and a blessing, from Us. This has been decreed.'"

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: He said: "So (it will be): Thy Lord saith, 'that is easy for Me: and (We wish) to appoint him as a Sign unto men and a Mercy from Us': It is a matter (so) decreed."

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: When she conceived him she went away to a distant place.

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: So she conceived him, and she went away with him to a far place.

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: So she conceived him, and withdrew with him to a distant place.

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: hen she conceived him, and she retired with him to a place far-off.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a far place (i.e. Bethlehem valley about 4-6 miles from Jerusalem).

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: So she carried him, and secluded herself with him in a remote place.

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: Then she conceived him and withdrew with him to a far-off place.

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: And she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a far place.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: Thereupon she carried him, and retired to a far off place.

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: She conceived the child and retreated with him to a distant and solitary place.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: So she conceived him; then withdrew herself with him to a remote place.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: So she conceived him and withdrew with him to a distant place.

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: So she conceived him, and she retired with him to a remote place.

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: The birth pangs led her to the trunk of a date-palm tree. "Would that I had died before this," she said, "and become a thing forgotten, unremembered."

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: Then the pangs of childbirth brought her to the base of the palm-tree; she said, “Oh, if only had I died before this and had become forgotten, unremembered.”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: And the birthpangs surprised her by the trunk of the palm-tree. She said, 'Would I had died ere this, and become a thing forgotten!'

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: Then the birth-pangs drave her to the trunk of a palm- tree; she said: would that had died afore this and become forgotten, lost in oblivion!

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a date-palm. She said: "Would that I had died before this, and had been forgotten and out of sight!"

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: The labor-pains came upon her, by the trunk of a palm-tree. She said, “I wish I had died before this, and been completely forgotten.”

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: Then the birth pangs drove her to the trunk of a palm-tree and she said: "Oh, would that I had died before this and had been all forgotten."

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a date palm. She said: "Would that I had died before this, and had been forgotten and out of sight!"

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: And the pangs of childbirth drove her unto the trunk of the palm-tree. She said: Oh, would that I had died ere this and had become a thing of naught, forgotten!

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: And when the birthpangs came upon her by the trunk of a palmtree, she said: 'Oh, would that I had died before this and become a thing forgotten'

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: When she started to experience (the pain of) of childbirth labor, by the trunk of a palm tree in sadness she said, "Would that I had died long before and passed into oblivion."

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: And the throes (of childbirth) compelled her to betake herself to the trunk of a palm tree. She said: Oh, would that I had died before this, and had been a thing quite forgotten!

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: The pains of labour drove her to the trunk of a date-palm. She said, "Oh, if only I had died before this and passed into oblivion!"

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm-tree: She cried (in her anguish): "Ah! would that I had died before this! would that I had been a thing forgotten and out of sight!"

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: Then (a voice) called to her from below: "Grieve not; your Lord has made a rivulet gush forth right below you.

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: (The angel) Therefore called her from below her, “Do not grieve – your Lord has made a river flow below you.”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: But the one that was below her called to her, 'Nay, do not sorrow; see, thy Lord has set below thee a rivulet.

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: Then one cried unto her from underneath her, that grieve not, thy Lord hath placed underneath thou a rivulet.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: Then [the babe 'Iesa (Jesus) or Jibrael (Gabriel)] cried unto her from below her, saying: "Grieve not! Your Lord has provided a water stream under you;

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: Whereupon he called her from beneath her: “Do not worry; your Lord has placed a stream beneath you.

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: Thereupon the angel below her cried out: "Grieve not, for your Lord has caused a stream of water to flow beneath you.

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: Then he cried unto her from below her, saying: "Grieve not: your Lord has provided a Sariy under you."

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: Then (one) cried unto her from below her, saying: Grieve not! Thy Lord hath placed a rivulet beneath thee,

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: He called from below to her: 'Do not sorrow, look, your Lord has provided a rivulet below you,

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: Then she heard the baby saying, "Do not be sad. Your Lord has caused a stream to run at your feet.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: Then (the child) called out to her from beneath her: Grieve not, surely your Lord has made a stream to flow beneath you;

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: But a voice called out to her from below, "Do not despair. Your Lord has provided a brook that runs at your feet,

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: But (a voice) cried to her from beneath the (palm-tree): "Grieve not! for thy Lord hath provided a rivulet beneath thee;

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: Shake the trunk of the date-palm tree, and it will drop ripe dates for you.

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: “And shake the trunk of the palm-tree towards you – ripe fresh dates will fall upon you.” (This was a miracle – the date palm was dry and it was winter season.)

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: Shake also to thee the palm-trunk, and there shall come tumbling upon thee dates fresh and ripe.

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: And shake toward thee the trunk of the palm-tree it shall drop on thee dates fresh and ripe.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: "And shake the trunk of date-palm towards you, it will let fall fresh ripe-dates upon you."

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: And shake the trunk of the palm-tree towards you, and it will drop ripe dates by you.”

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: Shake the trunk of the palm-tree towards yourself and fresh and ripe dates shall fall upon you.

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: "And shake the trunk of date palm towards you, it will let fall fresh ripe dates upon you."

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: And shake the trunk of the palm-tree toward thee, thou wilt cause ripe dates to fall upon thee.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: and shake the trunk of this palmtree it will drop fresh ripe dates upon you.

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: If you shake the trunk of the palm tree, it will provide you with fresh ripe dates.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: And shake towards you the trunk of the palmtree, it will drop on you fresh ripe dates:

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: and if you shake the trunk of this palm-tree, it will drop fresh ripe dates on you.

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: "And shake towards thyself the trunk of the palm-tree: It will let fall fresh ripe dates upon thee.

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: Eat and drink, and be at peace. If you see any man, tell him: 'I have verily vowed a fast to Ar-Rahman and cannot speak to any one this day.'

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: “Therefore eat and drink and appease your eyes; so if you meet any person then say, ‘I have pledged a fast (of silence) to the Most Gracious – I will therefore not speak to any person today.’”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: Eat therefore, and drink, and be comforted; and if thou shouldst see any mortal, say, "I have vowed to the All-merciful a fast, and today I will not speak to any man.

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: So eat and drink thou, and cool thine eyes; and if thou beholdest the human beings anyone, say: verily I have vowed to the Compassionate a fast, so I shall not speak today to any human being.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
