translations.text: "So eat and drink and be glad, and if you see any human being, say: 'Verily! I have vowed a fast unto the Most Beneficent (Allah) so I shall not speak to any human being this day. 

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: “So eat, and drink, and be consoled. And if you see any human, say, ‘I have vowed a fast to the Most Gracious, so I will not speak to any human today.'“

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: So eat and drink and cool your eyes; and if you see any person say to him: 'Verily I have vowed a fast to the Most Compassionate Lord, and so I shall not speak to anyone today.' "

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: "So eat and drink and rejoice. And if you see any human being, say: `Verily, I have vowed a fast for the Most Gracious so I shall not speak to any human being today.,"

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: So eat and drink and be consoled. And if thou meetest any mortal, say: Lo! I have vowed a fast unto the Beneficent, and may not speak this day to any mortal.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: Therefore eat and drink and rejoice with your eyes. If you meet any human say to him: "I have vowed a fast to the Merciful and will not speak with anyone today.'

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.' "

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: Eat, drink, and rejoice. Should you see a person going by, tell him that on this day you have promised the Beneficent God to fast and never talk to any human being."

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: So eat and drink and refresh the eye. Then if you see any mortal, say: Surely I have vowed a fast to the Beneficent Allah, so I shall not speak to any man today.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: Eat and drink and rejoice. And if you see any human being say, 'I have vowed a fast [of silence] to the Gracious God, and will not speak with any human being today.'"

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: "So eat and drink and cool (thine) eye. And if thou dost see any man, say, 'I have vowed a fast to (Allah) Most Gracious, and this day will I enter into not talk with any human being'"

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: Then she brought the child to her people. They exclaimed: "O Mary, you have done a most astonishing thing!

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: So carrying him in her arms, she brought him to her people; they said, “O Maryam, you have indeed committed a great evil!”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: Then she brought the child to her folk carrying him; and they said, 'Mary, thou hast surely committed a monstrous thing!

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: Then she brought him to her nation carrying him. They said: Maryam! assuredly thou hast brought a thing unheard Of.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: Then she brought him (the baby) to her people, carrying him. They said: "O Mary! Indeed you have brought a thing Fariya (an unheard mighty thing).

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: Then she came to her people, carrying him. They said, “O Mary, you have done something terrible.

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: Then she came to her people, carrying her baby. They said: "O Mary! You have committed a monstrous thing.

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said: "O Mary! Indeed you have brought a thing Fariy."

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: Then she brought him to her own folk, carrying him. They said: O Mary! Thou hast come with an amazing thing.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: She came to her nation, carrying him; and they said: 'O Mary, you have committed a monstrous thing.

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: She took him to her people and they said, "Mary, this is indeed an strange thing.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: And she came to her people with him, carrying him (with her). They said: O Marium! surely you have done a strange thing.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: Carrying her child, she brought him to her people. They said, "O Mary, you have indeed done something terrible!

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: At length she brought the (babe) to her people, carrying him (in her arms). They said: "O Mary! truly an amazing thing hast thou brought!

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: O sister of Aaron, your father was not a wicked person, nor your mother sinful!"

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: “O sister of Haroon, neither was your father an evil man nor was your mother of poor conduct!”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: Sister of Aaron, thy father was not a wicked man, nor was thy mother a woman unchaste.'

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: O sister of Harun: thy father was not a man of evil, nor was thy mother a harlot.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: "O sister (i.e. the like) of Harun (Aaron) [not the brother of Musa (Moses), but he was another pious man at the time of Maryam (Mary)]! Your father was not a man who used to commit adultery, nor your mother was an unchaste woman."

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: O sister of Aaron, your father was not an evil man, and your mother was not a whore.”

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: O sister of Aaron! Your father was not an evil man, nor was your mother an unchaste woman."

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: "O sister of Harun! Your father was not a man who used to commit adultery, nor your mother was an unchaste woman."

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: O sister of Aaron! Thy father was not a wicked man nor was thy mother a harlot.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: O sister of Aaron, your father was never an evil man, nor was your mother unchaste'

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: O sister of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: Aaron's sister, your father was not a bad man nor was your mother unchaste".

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: O sister of Haroun! your father was not a bad man, nor, was your mother an unchaste woman.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: Sister of Aaron, your father was not an evil man, nor was your mother an unchaste woman!"

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: "O sister of Aaron! Thy father was not a man of evil, nor thy mother a woman unchaste!"

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: But she pointed towards him. "How can we talk to one," they said, "who is only an infant in the cradle?"

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: Thereupon she pointed towards the child; they said, “How can we speak to an infant who is in the cradle?”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: Mary pointed to the child then; but they said, 'How shall we speak to one who is still in the cradle, a little child?'

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: Then she Pointed to him. They said: how shall we speak to one who is in the cradle, a child?

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: Then she pointed to him. They said: "How can we talk to one who is a child in the cradle?"

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: So she pointed to him. They said, “How can we speak to an infant in the crib?”

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: Thereupon Mary pointed to the child. They exclaimed: "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle, a mere child?"

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: Then she pointed to him. They said: "How can we talk to one who is a child in the cradle"

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: Then she pointed to him. They said: How can we talk to one who is in the cradle, a young boy?

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: So she pointed to him (Prophet Jesus). But they replied: 'How can we speak with a baby in the cradle'

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: She pointed to the baby (and referred them to him for their answer). They said, "How can we talk to a baby in the cradle?"

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: But she pointed to him. They said: How should we speak to one who was a child in the cradle?

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: She pointed to the child. They said, "How shall we talk to someone who is a child in the cradle?"

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: But she pointed to the babe. They said: "How can we talk to one who is a child in the cradle?"

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: "I am a servant of God," he answered. "He has given me a Book and made me a prophet,

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: The child proclaimed, “I am Allah’s bondman; He has given me the Book and made me a Herald of the Hidden (a Prophet).”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: He said, 'Lo, I am God's servant; God has given me the Book, and made me a Prophet.

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: He Said: verily I am a bondman of Allah; He hath vouchsafed me the Book and made me a prophet.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: "He ['Iesa (Jesus)] said: Verily! I am a slave of Allah, He has given me the Scripture and made me a Prophet;"

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: He said, “I am the servant of God. He has given me the Scripture, and made me a prophet.

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: The child cried out: "Verily I am Allah's servant. He has granted me the Book and has made me a Prophet

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: He said: "Verily, I am a servant of Allah, He has given me the Scripture and made me a Prophet;"

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: He spake: Lo! I am the slave of Allah. He hath given me the Scripture and hath appointed me a Prophet,

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: He (the baby) said: 'I am the worshiper of Allah. Allah has given me the Book and made me a Prophet.

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: He said, "I am the servant of God. He has given me the Book and has appointed me to be a Prophet.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: He said: Surely I am a servant of Allah; He has given me the Book and made me a prophet;

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: [But] he said, "I am God's servant. He has given me the Book and made me a prophet;

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: He said: "I am indeed a servant of Allah: He hath given me revelation and made me a prophet;

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: And blessed me wherever I may be, and enjoined on me worship and zakat for as long as I live,

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: “And He has made me blessed wherever I be; and ordained upon me prayer and charity, as long as I live.”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: Blessed He has made me, wherever I may be; and He has enjoined me to pray, and to give the alms, so long as I live,

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: And He hath made me blest wheresoever I may be, and enjoined on me the prayer and the poor-rate as long as I am alive.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: "And He has made me blessed wheresoever I be, and has enjoined on me Salat (prayer), and Zakat, as long as I live."

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: And has made me blessed wherever I may be; and has enjoined on me prayer and charity, so long as I live.

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: and has blessed me wherever I might be and has enjoined upon me Prayer and Zakah (purifying alms) as long as I live;

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: "And He has made me blessed wherever I be, and has enjoined on me [Awsani] Salah and Zakah, as long as I live."

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: And hath made me blessed wheresoever I may be, and hath enjoined upon me prayer and almsgiving so long as I remain alive,

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: He made me to be blessed wherever I am, and He has charged me with prayer and charity for as long as I shall live.

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I remain alive

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: He has blessed me no matter where I dwell, commanded me to worship Him and pay the religious tax for as long as I live.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: And He has made me blessed wherever I may be, and He has enjoined on me prayer and poor-rate so long as I live;

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: He has made me blessed wherever I may be, and has enjoined upon me prayer and almsgiving throughout my life.

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: "And He hath made me blessed wheresoever I be, and hath enjoined on me Prayer and Charity as long as I live;

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: And be dutiful to my mother. He has not made me haughty or rebellious.

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: “And has made me good to my mother and not made me forceful, ill-fated.”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: and likewise to cherish my mother; He has not made me arrogant, unprosperous.

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: And dutecus Unto my mother, and hath not made me high- handed, unblest.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: "And dutiful to my mother, and made me not arrogant, unblest.

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: And kind to my mother, and He did not make me a disobedient rebel.

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: and has made me dutiful to my mother. He has not made me oppressive, nor bereft of God's blessings.

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: "And to be dutiful to my mother, and made me not arrogant, unblessed."

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: And (hath made me) dutiful toward her who bore me, and hath not made me arrogant, unblest.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: (He has made me) kind to my mother; He has not made me arrogant, unprosperous.

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: He has commanded me to be good to my parents and has not made me an arrogant rebellious person.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: And dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me insolent, unblessed;

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: He has made me dutiful toward my mother, and He has not made me arrogant or wicked.

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: "(He) hath made me kind to my mother, and not overbearing or miserable;

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: There was peace on me the day I was born, and will be the day I die, and on the day I will be raised from the dead."

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: “And peace is upon me the day I was born, and on the day I shall taste death, and on the day I will be raised alive.”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: Peace be upon me, the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I am raised up alive!'

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: And peace be on me the day was born and the day die and the day I shall be raised up alive.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: "And Salam (peace) be upon me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive!"

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: So Peace is upon me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the Day I get resurrected alive.”

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: Peace be upon me the day I was born and the day I will die, and the day I will be raised up alive."

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: "And Salam (peace) be upon me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive!"

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: Peace on me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive!

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: Peace be upon me on the day I was born, and on the day I die; and on the day when I shall be raised up alive'

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: I was born with peace and I shall die and be brought to life again with peace."

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: And peace on me on the day I was born, and on the day I die, and on the day I am raised to life.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: Blessed was I on the day I was born, and blessed I shall be on the day I die and on the day I am raised to life again."

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: "So peace is on me the day I was born, the day that I die, and the day that I shall be raised up to life (again)"!

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: This was Jesus, son of Mary: A true account they contend about.

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: This is Eisa (Jesus), the son of Maryam; a true statement, in which they doubt.

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: That is Jesus, son of Mary, in word of truth, concerning which they are doubting.

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: Such is 'lsa, son of Maryam: this Is the word of truth wherein they are doubting.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: Such is 'Iesa (Jesus), son of Maryam (Mary). (it is) a statement of truth, about which they doubt (or dispute).

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: That is Jesus son of Mary—the Word of truth about which they doubt.

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: This is Jesus, the son of Mary; and this is the truth about him concerning which they are in doubt.

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: Such is `Isa, son of Maryam. Qawlal-Haqq [it is a statement of truth] about which they doubt (or dispute).

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: Such was Jesus, son of Mary: (this is) a statement of the truth concerning which they doubt.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: Such was (Prophet) Jesus, the son of Mary. A saying of truth, concerning what they doubt.

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: Such was the true story of Jesus, the son of Mary, about which they dispute bitterly.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: Such is Isa, son of Marium; (this is) the saying of truth about which they dispute.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: Such was Jesus, the son of Mary. That is the whole truth, about which they still dispute:

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: Such (was) Jesus the son of Mary: (it is) a statement of truth, about which they (vainly) dispute.

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: And because they denied and spoke dreadful calumnies of Mary;

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: And because they disbelieved and slandered Maryam with a tremendous accusation.

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: and for their unbelief, and their uttering against Mary a mighty calumny,

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: And for their blasphemy and for their speaking against Maryam a mighty calumny.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: And because of their (Jews) disbelief and uttering against Maryam (Mary) a grave false charge (that she has committed illegal sexual intercourse);

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: And for their faithlessness, and their saying against Mary a monstrous slander.

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: and for their going so far in unbelief as uttering against Mary a mighty calumny,

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: And because of their disbelief and uttering against Maryam a grave false charge.

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: And because of their disbelief and of their speaking against Mary a tremendous calumny;

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: Also for their disbelief and their saying about Mary a great calumny,

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: And [We cursed them] for their disbelief and their saying against Mary a great slander,

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: Their hearts were also sealed because of their lack of faith, their gravely slanderous accusation against Mary,

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: And for their unbelief and for their having uttered against Marium a grievous calumny.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: They denied the truth and uttered a monstrous slander against Mary.

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: That they rejected Faith; that they uttered against Mary a grave false charge;

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: (Remember) her who preserved her chastity, into whom We breathed a new life from Us, and made her and her son a token for mankind.

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: And remember the woman who maintained her chastity, We therefore breathed Our Spirit into her and made her and her son a sign for the entire world.

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: And she who guarded her virginity, so We breathed into her of Our spirit and appointed her and her son to be a sign unto all beings.

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: And she who guarded her chastity! Then We breathed into her of Our spirit, and made her and her son a sign unto the worlds.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: And (remember) she who guarded her chastity [Virgin Maryam (Mary)], We breathed into (the sleeves of) her (shirt or garment) [through Our Ruh - Jibrael (Gabriel)], and We made her and her son ['Iesa (Jesus)] a sign for Al-'Alamin (the mankind and jinns).

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: And she who guarded her virginity. We breathed into her of Our spirit, and made her and her son a sign to the world.

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: And also recall the woman who guarded her chastity: We breathed into her of Our spirit, and made her and her son a Sign to the whole world.

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: And she who guarded her chastity, We breathed into her through Our Ruh, and We made her and her son a sign for nations.

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: And she who was chaste, therefor We breathed into her (something) of Our Spirit and made her and her son a token for (all) peoples.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: And she (Mary) who guarded her virginity. We breathed into her of Our spirit (Gabriel), and made her and her son a sign for the worlds.

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity, so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds.

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: Into the woman who maintained her chastity We breathed Our Spirit and made her and her son a miracle for all people.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: And she who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her of Our inspiration and made her and her son a sign for the nations.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: Remember the one who guarded her chastity; so We breathed Our Spirit into her, and made her and her son a sign for all people.

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: And (remember) her who guarded her chastity: We breathed into her of Our spirit, and We made her and her son a sign for all peoples.

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and gave them shelter on an elevated ground, sequestered, watered by a spring.

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: And We made the son of Maryam (Prophet Eisa) and his mother a sign, and We gave them shelter on a height, a place to stay and visible springs.

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: and We made Mary's son, and his mother, to be a sign, and gave them refuge upon a height, where was a hollow and a spring:

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: And We made the son of Maryam and his mother a sign; and We sheltered the twain on a height: a quiet abode and running water.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: And We made the son of Maryam (Mary) and his mother as a sign, And We gave them refuge on high ground, a place of rest, security and flowing streams.

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: And We made Mary’s son and his mother a sign, and We sheltered them on high ground with security and flowing springs.

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: And We made Mary's son, and his mother, a Sign, and We gave them refuge on a lofty ground, a peaceful site with springs flowing in it.

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: And We made the son of Maryam and his mother as a sign, and We gave them refuge on a Rabwah, Dhat Qarar, and Ma`in.

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a portent, and We gave them refuge on a height, a place of flocks and watersprings.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and gave them a refuge on a hillside where there was a hollow and a spring.

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: We made the son of Mary and his mother a miracle and settled them on a high land, quite secure and watered by a spring.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: And We made the son of Marium and his mother a sign, and We gave them a shelter on a lofty ground having meadows and springs.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and gave them shelter on a peaceful hillside watered by a fresh spring.

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: And We made the son of Mary and his mother as a Sign: We gave them both shelter on high ground, affording rest and security and furnished with springs.

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: And God presents the example of Pharaoh's wife for those who believe, when she said: "O Lord, build me a house in Paradise, and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds, and save me from a wicked people;"

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: And Allah illustrates an example of the Muslims – the wife of Firaun; when she prayed, “My Lord! Build a house for me near You, in Paradise, and deliver me from Firaun and his works, and rescue me from the unjust people.”

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: God has struck a similitude for the believers -- the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, 'My Lord, build for me a house in Paradise, in Thy presence, and deliver me from Pharaoh and his work, and do Thou deliver me from the people of the evildoers.'

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: And Allah propoundeth for those who believe the similitude of the wife Of Fir'awn, when she said: 'my Lord! build me in Thine presence a house in the Garden, and deliver me from Fir'awn and his handiwork, and deliver me from the transgressing people.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: And Allah has set forth an example for those who believe, the wife of Fir'aun (Pharaoh), when she said: "My Lord! Build for me a home with You in Paradise, and save me from Fir'aun (Pharaoh) and his work, and save me from the people who are Zalimun (polytheists, wrong-doers and disbelievers in Allah).

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: And God illustrates an example of those who believe: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, “My Lord, build for me, with you, a house in Paradise, and save me from Pharaoh and his works, and save me from the wrongdoing people.”

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: Allah has set forth for the believers the parable of Pharaoh's wife. She prayed: “My Lord, build for me a house with You in Paradise and deliver me from Pharaoh and his misdeeds; and deliver me from the iniquitous people.”

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: And Allah has set forth an example for those who believe: the wife of Fir`awn, when she said: "My Lord! Build for me a home with You in Paradise, and save me from Fir`awn and his work, and save me from the people who are wrongdoers.

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: And Allah citeth an example for those who believe: the wife of Pharaoh when she said: My Lord! Build for me a home with thee in the Garden, and deliver me from Pharaoh and his work, and deliver me from evil-doing folk;

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: But to those who believe Allah has given as an example Pharaoh's wife, who said: 'My Lord, build me a house before You in Paradise and save me fromPharaoh and his work, and save me from a harmdoing nation'

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: And Allah presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people."

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: To the believers, as a parable, God has told the story of the wife of the Pharaoh who said, "Lord, establish for me a house in Paradise in your presence. Rescue me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the unjust people.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: And Allah sets forth an example to those who believe the wife of Firon when she said: My Lord! build for me a house with Thee in the garden and deliver me from Firon and his doing, and deliver me from the unjust people:

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: To the believers God has given the example of Pharaoh's wife who said: "My Lord, build me a house in nearness to You in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his misdeeds. Save me from all evil-doers."

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: And Allah sets forth, as an example to those who believe the wife of Pharaoh: Behold she said: "O my Lord! Build for me, in nearness to Thee, a mansion in the Garden, and save me from Pharaoh and his doings, and save me from those that do wrong";

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: And of Mary, daughter of 'Imran, who guarded her chastity, so that We breathed into her a new life from Us, and she believed the words of her Lord and His Books, and was among the obedient.

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: And the example of Maryam the daughter of Imran, who guarded her chastity – We therefore breathed into her a Spirit from Ourselves – and she testified for the Words of her Lord and His Books, and was among the obedient.

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: And Mary, Imran's daughter, who guarded her virginity, so We breathed into her of Our Spirit, and she confirmed the Words of her Lord and His Books, and became one of the obedient.

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: And the similitude of Maryram daughter of lmran, who preserved her chastity, wherefore We breathed in it Of Our Spirit. And she testified to the words of her Lord and His Books and she was of the devout.

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: And Maryam (Mary), the daughter of 'Imran who guarded her chastity; and We breathed into (the sleeve of her shirt or her garment) through Our Ruh [i.e. Jibrael (Gabriel)], and she testified to the truth of the Words of her Lord [i.e. believed in the Words of Allah: "Be!" and he was; that is 'Iesa (Jesus) - son of Maryam (Mary); as a Messenger of Allah], and (also believed in) His Scriptures, and she was of the Qanitin (i.e. obedient to Allah).

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: And Mary, the daughter of Imran, who guarded her womb, and so We breathed into her of Our Spirit; and she believed in the truth of her Lord’s Words and His Books, and was one of the devout.

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: Allah has also set forth the parable of Mary, the daughter of Imran, who guarded her chastity, and into whom We breathed of Our Spirit, and who testified to the words of her Lord and His Books. She was among the obedient.

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: And Maryam, the daughter of `Imran who guarded her chastity (private part). And We breathed into it through Our Ruh, and she testified to the truth of her Lords Kalimat, and His Kutub, and she was of the Qanitin.

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: And Mary, daughter of 'Imran, whose body was chaste, therefor We breathed therein something of Our Spirit. And she put faith in the words of her Lord and His scriptures, and was of the obedient.

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: And, Mary, 'Imran's daughter, who guarded her chastity so We breathed into her of Our Spirit (Gabriel); and she put her trust in the Words of her Lord andHis Books, and was among the devout.

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: And [the example of] Mary, the daughter of 'Imran, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into [her garment] through Our angel, and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient.

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: He has also told, as a parable, the story of Mary, daughter of Imran who preserved her virginity and (into whose womb) We breathed Our spirit. She made the words of her Lord and the predictions in His Books come true. She was an obedient woman.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: And Marium, the daughter of Imran, who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her of Our inspiration and she accepted the truth of the words of her Lord and His books, and she was of, the obedient ones.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: [God gave another example in the story of] Mary, 'Imran's daughter, who preserved her chastity and We breathed Our spirit into her; she testified to the words of her Lord and His Scriptures, and was truly devout.

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: And Mary the daughter of 'Imran, who guarded her chastity; and We breathed into (her body) of Our spirit; and she testified to the truth of the words of her Lord and of His Revelations, and was one of the devout (servants).

translations.author: Ahmed Ali
translations.text: The Christ, son of Mary, was but an apostle, and many apostles had (come and) gone before him; and his mother was a woman of truth. They both ate the (same) food (as men). Behold, how We show men clear signs, and behold, how they wander astray!

translations.author: Ahmed Raza Khan
translations.text: The Messiah, the son of Maryam, is purely a Noble Messenger; many Noble Messengers have passed before him; and his mother is a truthful woman; they both used to eat food; see how We make the signs clear for them, and see how they turn away!

translations.author: Arberry
translations.text: The Messiah, son of Mary, was only a Messenger; Messengers before him passed away; his mother was a just woman; they both ate food. Behold, how We make clear the signs to them; then behold, how they perverted are!

translations.author: Daryabadi
translations.text: The Masih, son of Maryam, was naught but an apostle; surely there passed away apostles before him and his mother was a saintly woman; both of them were wont to eat food. Behold! how We expound unto them the evidences! Then behold! whither they are deviating!

translations.author: Hilali & Khan
translations.text: The Messiah ['Iesa (Jesus)], son of Maryam (Mary), was no more than a Messenger; many were the Messengers that passed away before him. His mother [Maryam (Mary)] was a Siddiqah [i.e. she believed in the words of Allah and His Books (see Verse 66:12)]. They both used to eat food (as any other human being, while Allah does not eat). Look how We make the Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) clear to them, yet look how they are deluded away (from the truth).

translations.author: Itani
translations.text: The Messiah son of Mary was only a messenger, before whom other Messengers had passed away, and his mother was a woman of truth. They both used to eat food. Note how We make clear the revelations to them; then note how deluded they are.

translations.author: Maududi
translations.text: The Messiah, son of Mary, was no more than a Messenger before whom many Messengers have passed away; and his mother adhered wholly to truthfulness, and they both ate food (as other mortals do). See how We make Our signs clear to them; and see where they are turning away!

translations.author: Mubarakpuri
translations.text: The Messiah [`Isa], son of Maryam, was no more than a Messenger; many were the Messengers that passed away before him. His mother [Maryam] was a Siddiqah. They both used to eat food. Look how We make the Ayat clear to them; yet look how they are deluded away (from the truth).

translations.author: Pickthall
translations.text: The Messiah, son of Mary, was no other than a messenger, messengers (the like of whom) had passed away before him. And his mother was a saintly woman. And they both used to eat (earthly) food. See how We make the revelations clear for them, and see how they are turned away!

translations.author: Qaribullah & Darwish
translations.text: The Messiah, the son of Mary, was not except a Messenger, other Messengers had gone before him. His mother was in the state of sincerity, they both ate food. See how We make plain to them Our signs. Then, see how perverted they are.

translations.author: Saheeh International
translations.text: The Messiah, son of Mary, was not but a messenger; [other] messengers have passed on before him. And his mother was a supporter of truth. They both used to eat food. Look how We make clear to them the signs; then look how they are deluded.

translations.author: Sarwar
translations.text: Jesus, the son of Mary, was no more than a Messenger before whom there lived many other Messengers. His mother was a truthful woman and both of them ate earthly food. Consider how We explain the evidence (of the Truth) to them and see where they then turn.

translations.author: Shakir
translations.text: The Messiah, son of Marium is but an apostle; apostles before him have indeed passed away; and his mother was a truthful woman; they both used to eat food. See how We make the communications clear to them, then behold, how they are turned away.

translations.author: Wahiduddin Khan
translations.text: Christ, son of Mary, was no more than a messenger. Many messengers passed away before him. His mother was a virtuous woman; and they both ate food [like other mortals]. See how We make the signs clear to them! See how they turn away!

translations.author: Yusuf Ali
translations.text: Christ the son of Mary was no more than a messenger; many were the messengers that passed away before him. His mother was a woman of truth. They had both to eat their (daily) food. See how Allah doth make His signs clear to them; yet see in what ways they are deluded away from the truth!

translations.author: Dr. Muhammad Muhsin
translations.text:
Narrated 'Ali:
The Prophet said, "The best of the world's women is Mary (at her lifetime), and the best of the world's women is Khadija (at her lifetime)."

translations.author: Dr. Muhammad Muhsin
translations.text:
Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari:
Allah's Apostle said, "Many amongst men attained perfection but amongst women none attained the perfection except Mary, the daughter of Imran and Asiya, the wife of Pharaoh. And the superiority of 'Aisha to other women is like the superiority of Tharid (i.e. an Arabic dish) to other meals."
